# Independent post-pointer capsule review

Reviewed `qualification.json` SHA-256 `573d8a2252d137ba9cc6bf0c87f90c87bcacda395ca151355facb6fa4413956a`. No browser or producer rerun was performed. The capsule supports its bounded post-pointer observations; it is not a full matrix, coordinator admission, security, or release qualification.

All 18 listed capsule members and three stated tool executables rehashed as recorded. The four retained command-exit files each contain zero. Packed-consumer and engine-free logs identify their producer outcomes and derived counts, but do not themselves preserve complete parent shell invocation lines; this review treats exit files and logs as retained local observations, not coordinator-attested command execution. The RxJS log does preserve the build and Karma child commands.

The actual d24d26758d34b6a68693b71f1cf38f037c5d9d5d18bc4466dfe15118477781da tarball rehashed. Independently compared all 1,120 preflight tracked source Git blob IDs with commit 45bbb3016f631296c08cf0eaa5f54a0e61455cf1 and checked 398 embedded source-map images against those blob hashes. Forty-five synthetic source-map paths were excluded; this comparison does not prove the build process itself. The RxJS fixture's autocomplete spec is c049c617e9a3dc7f59c6383d0391e6d59813f5b6ca72374db3c3082e1f8b1683, matching the landed test.

The packed report has 106 distinct passing cases, artifact hash d24d..., and current supported configuration Angular/CDK/Material 22.1.7, RxJS 7.8.2, TypeScript 6.0.3 and Node 24.21.0. Its retained package lock contains one RxJS 7.8.2. The engine-free log reports 37 derived cases and success; its report identifies the same artifact, no installed animation engine, both expected animation imports unresolved, and passing strict-template/runtime checks. All 809 regular copied engine fixture scripts matched the current source bytes at review time.

The RxJS 6 report records 198/198 autocomplete cases, zero skipped, including the new pointer case; its artifact hash matches d24d.... The fixture lock contains one RxJS 6.5.3 and its installed core/CDK/Material and animations are 22.1.7 with TypeScript 6.0.2. The metafile contains 200 RxJS inputs, all under the isolated `node_modules/rxjs`, and its autocomplete FESM input is from the extracted diagnostic artifact; no canonical-worktree module path was found. The diagnostic run manifest explicitly says it is a synthetic wrapper, not a new pack-provenance receipt. The prior fixture's runner uses the previously documented isolated preserveSymlinks/metafile change.

The qualification's 2,323-case roster is static; only autocomplete was run here. The inventory was stale at the reviewed checkpoint. No claim is made that 22 historical families, another browser, other floor combinations, G01–G13, or the upstream subject have been admitted.
